Privacy Policy

Draft for company review · Updated 9 October 2026

This policy describes the information handled through AtmoraTech’s website, demo enquiries and recruitment forms. For privacy questions, contact aakansha.gupta@atmoratech.com or +91 7208088453.

Information you provide

Enquiry fields include your name, company, email, phone number, optional website link and requirement. Recruitment fields include your name, email, phone number, preferred role and CV. Provide only information relevant to your enquiry or application, and avoid including identity documents, banking details or other unnecessary sensitive information.

Purpose of use

Enquiry details are intended to help us understand your requirement, arrange a demo and respond to you. Application details are intended to help us assess your profile and communicate about recruitment. The contact consent does not sign you up for unrelated promotional messages.

This review version

In this Phase 2 preview, enquiry details are held only in page memory until reload. The Career form validates the selected CV locally; it does not upload the file or send an application. Supabase storage and live form submission will be implemented in Phase 3, and this notice will be updated to describe the actual handling before launch.

Service providers and external links

Live operation may require authorized hosting, database, communications or recruitment providers to process relevant information for the stated purpose. Confirm the providers, storage locations and access controls before launch. WhatsApp opens an external chat service, and its own privacy terms apply. Email and telephone links open the services configured on your device.

Retention and security

For the live site, retain enquiry and application information only for the relevant business purpose or an applicable legal requirement, with a documented deletion schedule. Restrict access to authorized staff and use appropriate security measures. The final retention period and production controls must be confirmed before accepting live submissions.

Your requests

You can contact the email above to ask about your information, correct details, request deletion, withdraw contact consent or raise a privacy concern. Requests will be addressed in accordance with applicable law and any legitimate retention requirement. Withdrawal may prevent us from continuing an enquiry or application.

Cookies and children

This review version does not use analytics, advertising cookies or browser storage for form data. Any future analytics or optional cookies will be described before activation. The website’s enquiry and recruitment services are intended for adults; do not submit personal information on behalf of a child.

Changes and contact

We may update this notice as website features change. The date above identifies the current draft. Office: 702, 7th Floor, C-2, Padwal Nagar, Thane West, Thane, Maharashtra 400604.

Terms & Conditions

Draft for company review · Updated 9 October 2026

These terms apply to the use of AtmoraTech’s website. Project services, software subscriptions and implementation work are governed by a separately agreed proposal, statement of work or service agreement.

Website information and demos

Service and solution information is provided to explain our capabilities. Availability, features, integrations, scope, timelines and commercials must be confirmed in the relevant written agreement. A demo request does not create a service contract. Illustrative images and sample blog content in this UI preview are not evidence of client relationships or product performance.

Acceptable use

Use the website lawfully. Do not attempt unauthorized access, interfere with its operation, submit malicious files, impersonate another person or provide information you are not authorized to share.

Enquiries and applications

Provide accurate contact details and relevant information. Submission does not guarantee a response time, quotation, employment opportunity or selection. In this Phase 2 preview, the forms are demonstrations and do not send entries or upload CVs.

Content and intellectual property

Website text, branding and software-related materials are owned by AtmoraTech or used with permission, subject to the rights of their respective owners. Do not reproduce or redistribute protected material without permission. Ownership and licensing of project deliverables are defined in the relevant contract.

Third party services

Links to WhatsApp and other external services are provided for convenience. Those services operate under their own terms and privacy policies. AtmoraTech does not control their availability or content.

Availability and responsibility

We aim to keep website information accurate but may update or correct it. Website access may be interrupted for maintenance or other reasons. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not responsible for losses arising from reliance on general website information or external services. These terms do not exclude rights or liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Privacy and Indian law

Personal information is addressed in the Privacy Policy. These website terms are governed by the laws of India, subject to mandatory legal protections. Any project-specific dispute process should be set out in the signed agreement; website disputes may be addressed through the competent courts under applicable law.

Contact and changes

Questions can be sent to aakansha.gupta@atmoratech.com, or raised at +91 7208088453. Office: 702, 7th Floor, C-2, Padwal Nagar, Thane West, Thane, Maharashtra 400604. Review changes periodically; the date above identifies this draft.
